Address to balance mapping in BasicToken, credited/debited by transfers and minting
Nested allowance mapping in StandardToken used by approve/transferFrom
Ownable owner address, set from msg.sender and enforced by onlyOwner
Pausable emergency stop flag gating most public functions
MintableToken flag that permanently blocks minting
Avatar flag required by canTransfer for holder transfers
Avatar token-per-wei conversion rate used by buyTokens
Accumulated ether raised, drives bonus tiers and cap logic

Avatar flag that terminates the crowdsale window
Constant crowdsale token cap checked in buyTokens
Constant global mint cap checked in mintInternal
BasicToken.transfer: deducts msg.sender balance and credits _to
StandardToken.transferFrom: spends allowance and moves balances
StandardToken.approve: sets allowance with zero-allowance race guard
Ownable.transferOwnership: onlyOwner reassignment of ownership
Pausable.pause: onlyOwner sets paused true
Pausable.unpause: onlyOwner sets paused false
MintableToken.mint: onlyOwner whenNotPaused entry that calls mintInternal
Internal minting routine enforcing caps and updating supply/balances
Avatar.buyTokens: payable crowdsale logic computing bonus tokens and minting
Avatar payable fallback forwarding all calls to buyTokens(msg.sender)
Internal routine forwarding collected ether to the wallet address
Avatar.changeRate: owner/approved user updates conversion rate
Avatar.setApprovedUser: onlyOwner updates the approved account
Avatar.changeWallet: onlyOwner updates the fund collection address
msg.sender, attacker-controllable caller identity used for auth and accounting
SafeMath library sub/add arithmetic on balances performed by transfer
mul/div/add arithmetic computing token amount and bonus in buyTokens
External ether transfer wallet.transfer(msg.value) sending funds to an address
SafeMath add arithmetic updating totalSupply and balances during minting
_to parameter of BasicToken.transfer, destination address
_value parameter of BasicToken.transfer, amount moved
beneficiary parameter of buyTokens receiving minted tokens
weiAmount local capturing msg.value inside buyTokens
bonus local percentage chosen by the tier if/else chain
totalWei local sum of weiAmount and weiFounded driving bonus tiers
tokens local computed from rate and bonus before minting
_from parameter of transferFrom, debited address
_rate parameter of changeRate, new conversion rate
_user parameter of setApprovedUser, new privileged address
_allowance local caching allowed[_from][msg.sender] in transferFrom

edges.reason: Fallback payable entry forwards every plain ether transfer to buyTokens
mint delegates token creation to mintInternal
buyTokens calls mintInternal to create purchased tokens
buyTokens calls forwardFunds at the end of the sale flow
transfer performs SafeMath sub/add arithmetic on balances that is wrapped in asserts
transfer writes updated balances for sender and recipient
transferFrom debits _from and credits _to in balances
transferFrom decrements the caller allowance in allowed
approve writes the new allowance into allowed
mintInternal accumulates totalSupply with SafeMath add
mintInternal credits the beneficiary balance with newly minted tokens
mintInternal compares totalSupply against maxTokensToMint cap
buyTokens computes tokens and bonus with mul/div/add arithmetic
buyTokens adds msg.value into weiFounded after the tier evaluation
buyTokens multiplies contributed wei by the mutable rate state variable
buyTokens checks totalSupply plus tokens against maxTokenToBuy
buyTokens is gated by the icoFinished state flag in canBuyTokens
forwardFunds performs an external ether transfer to a caller-influenced address
forwardFunds sends the contract balance to the wallet state variable
buyTokens uses msg.sender as the default beneficiary of the purchase
transfer derives the debited account from msg.sender
transferFrom spends the allowance keyed by msg.sender
approve keys the allowance owner by msg.sender
Ownable constructor assigns owner from msg.sender
changeRate authorization compares msg.sender to owner/approvedUser
setApprovedUser authorization requires msg.sender equals owner
changeWallet authorization requires msg.sender equals owner
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender to owner
pause is guarded by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender to owner
mint is guarded by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender to owner
_to parameter determines the credited balance in transfer
_value parameter feeds the sub/add arithmetic in transfer
beneficiary parameter receives the minted tokens in buyTokens
weiAmount local feeds the token and bonus multiplication
bonus local feeds the extra token percentage arithmetic
totalWei local drives the bonus tier comparisons
tokens local is passed into mintInternal for supply arithmetic
_from parameter determines the debited balance in transferFrom
_rate parameter overwrites the rate state variable
_user parameter overwrites the approvedUser state variable
_allowance local holds the cached allowance before subtraction

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only meaningful as the destination of BasicToken.transfer and collapses into that function node
_value only feeds the balance arithmetic inside transfer and merges into that function node
beneficiary only parameterizes the buyTokens purchase and merges into that function node
weiAmount is a temporary for the arithmetic in buyTokens and merges into the unsafe arithmetic node
bonus is a temporary percentage used by the buyTokens arithmetic and merges into the unsafe arithmetic node
totalWei is a temporary tier sum used by buyTokens arithmetic and merges into the unsafe arithmetic node
tokens is the minted amount handed to mintInternal and merges into that minting function node
_from only selects the debited account in transferFrom and merges into that function node
_rate is only assigned to the rate state variable in changeRate and merges into that function node
_user is only assigned to the approvedUser state variable in setApprovedUser and merges into that function node
_allowance is a cached allowance temporary inside transferFrom and merges into that function node
